deletion_trials.reason: Removing the irreparability determination leaves the invalid square-root inference unaddressed, although x=1 and y=-1 satisfy x^2=y^2 but not x=y.

reason: The proposed patch correctly marks the proof irreparable without changing the stated theorem, assumptions, or real-number domain. Over the reals, x^2=y^2 implies (x-y)(x+y)=0, hence x=y or x=-y. The instance x=1, y=-1 satisfies the hypothesis but falsifies the conclusion, so no valid proof of the exact stated theorem exists. Marking irreparability is therefore the minimal valid local resolution of the failed inference.
